Notable Accomplishments

Managed the largest music concert in the U.S. - Thanksgiving Music Concert in 1982 and other big music concerts in Southern California.

Organized the North American Taiwanese Literature and Art Association (北美洲台灣人文藝協會) and the North American Culture Association Chamber Orchestra (北美文協室內樂團).
